t: Honey treats can be fed to angry bees to calm them down. Feeding them to baby bees will make them grow up faster.$(br2)Honey treats can also bee combined with genes to transfer genetics from one bee to another. Read more on the $(l:genetics/transferring)genetics page$(/l)
蜜蜂小食可以喂给愤怒的蜜蜂，让它们冷静下来。喂给幼蜂则能让它们更快长大。$(br2)蜜蜂小食还可以与基因结合，用于在蜜蜂之间转移遗传特性。更多内容请阅读$(l:genetics/transferring)基因工程页面$(/l)
